tagline: Leading news, sports and entertainment media company
hero_kpi_rationale: Advertising revenue is a key driver for FOXA, with a 26% increase in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to higher revenues from sports programming, including Super Bowl LIX and higher NFL pricing.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate risk is high due to $6.7 billion of fixed-rate debt, which could impact the market value of debt if interest rates change. (Item 7A, page 49)

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Market risk is high due to investments in equity securities of publicly traded companies, which could impact the value of these investments if market prices change. (Item 7A, page 50)

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is present due to concentration of credit exposure among certain customers, which could impact the company's ability to collect receivables. (Note 2, page 50)

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Litigation risk is high due to ongoing legal proceedings for defamation or disparagement, which could impact the company's reputation and financial condition. (Note 14, page 54)

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputation risk is high due to ongoing legal proceedings for defamation or disparagement, which could impact the company's reputation. (Note 14, page 54)

risks.title: Internal Control Risk
risks.score_rationale: Internal control risk is present due to the complexity of the company's operations, which could impact the company's ability to manage and monitor its activities. (Page 51)

risks.title: Programming Rights Risk
risks.score_rationale: Programming rights risk is present due to sports programming contracts, which could impact the company's ability to amortize these rights. (Note 2, page 53)

risks.title: Amortization Risk
risks.score_rationale: Amortization risk is present due to sports programming contracts, which could impact the company's ability to amortize these rights. (Note 2, page 53)

ai_positioning.summary: Fox Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K report for the 2025 fiscal year. There is no strategic, operational, or technological reference to AI.
